description: Natural gas (and optionally liquids) pipelines near a Texas address or coordinate from Railroad Commission of Texas T-4 permit data: operator, system name, commodity, nominal diameter, interstate or intrastate, transmission or gathering, distance in miles and miles of line within the radius, plus a summary (nearest line, largest diameter, nearest 12-inch-plus, nearest interstate). Use when someone asks about gas supply for a behind-the-meter plant, generator or data center, which pipelines cross or border a tract, or who the pipeline operators are near a site. Also returns gas_infrastructure within 15 miles: the nearest trunklines (20-inch-plus or interstate), compressor stations (HIFLD certificated horsepower, TCEQ gas transmission sites), processing plants with design capacity and throughput in MMcf/d, and EIA-tracked capacity expansion projects by the operators of those lines. Line capacity and available takeaway are not public; this finds who to call.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

gas_only.description: Only natural gas lines. Default true; false adds crude, HVL/NGL, refined products, CO2.

interstate.description: Pro. Keep only interstate (FERC-regulated) or only intrastate (Railroad Commission regulated) systems. Default all. Free calls get all systems plus a note.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

min_diameter_in.description: Only systems with at least this nominal diameter in inches, e.g. 12 for transmission-scale supply.

radius_mi.description: Search radius in miles. Default 5, max 25.

name: pipelines_near
title: Gas pipelines near a site
